{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "afc52ab91691739eb8f946a0dc4b9573cf709b7c2cad22a019f98be15a323af6",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"LocalDef001","meaning":"The endpoints are strictly increasing, the field is interval integrable, and the proposed average equals its normalized interval integral.","effect_on_target":"Each of four average assertions includes endpoint ordering, integrability, and equality to the explicitly supplied average.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"LocalDef002","meaning":"The integral over a region, multiplied by the reciprocal of the real conversion of that region's measure.","effect_on_target":"Defines the region averages compared with the old spatial average and the left temporal flux average.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"LocalDef003","meaning":"For a real module, returns oldAverage minus (timeStep/cellVolume) times netOutwardFlux.","effect_on_target":"The updated vector is numericalOld(cell) minus (t-s)/(b-a) times the right numerical flux minus the left numerical flux.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"LocalDef004","meaning":"For a vector-valued field f and real endpoints l,r, returns (r-l) inverse times its oriented interval integral from l to r.","effect_on_target":"Defines all four spatial or temporal reference averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"Algebra.id","meaning":"A commutative semiring acts on itself through multiplication, with identity algebra map.","effect_on_target":"Real scalar action on each real coordinate is ordinary multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"Algebra.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts the scalar multiplication from an algebra structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real scalar action used coordinatewise on vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"And","meaning":"Logical conjunction.","effect_on_target":"All displayed conclusion clauses hold together; the average predicates also contain conjunctions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"CommSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Forgets commutativity from a commutative semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real semiring structure for scalar action without changing operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"DivInvMonoid.toDiv","meaning":"Extracts division from a division-and-inversion monoid structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real division in the time-to-length ratio.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"Eq","meaning":"Equality of two objects of the same type.","effect_on_target":"Vector equalities assert equality in every coordinate, rather than an approximate or almost-everywhere relation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"Fin","meaning":"Fin m is the finite index type of natural numbers less than m.","effect_on_target":"Vectors have coordinates indexed by 0 through m-1.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"Fin.fintype","meaning":"Enumerates all elements of Fin n using finRange n.","effect_on_target":"Makes the coordinate index finite for product norm and normed-space constructions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"Function.hasSMul","meaning":"Lifts scalar multiplication to functions pointwise.","effect_on_target":"Scalar multiples of vectors multiply each coordinate by the same real number.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"HAdd.hAdd","meaning":"Extracts the selected addition operation.","effect_on_target":"Uses real addition for bounds and pointwise addition for vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"HDiv.hDiv","meaning":"Extracts the selected division operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms the real ratio (t-s)/(b-a).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"HMul.hMul","meaning":"Extracts the selected multiplication operation.","effect_on_target":"Multiplies the ratio by the sum of the two flux-error bounds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"HSMul.hSMul","meaning":"Extracts the selected scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Scales averages, updates, and vector errors by real numbers.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"HSub.hSub","meaning":"Extracts the selected subtraction operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms endpoint differences, vector errors, and signed flux differences.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace","meaning":"Extracts the underlying normed-space structure of an inner-product space.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real coordinate normed-space structure; it does not specify a Euclidean product norm on the vector space.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"IntervalIntegrable","meaning":"Integrability on both (a,b] and (b,a] with the given measure.","effect_on_target":"For the ordered endpoints here, requires integrability on the forward half-open interval; the reverse interval is empty.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"LE.le","meaning":"Extracts the non-strict order relation.","effect_on_target":"All error-bound comparisons are non-strict real inequalities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"LT.lt","meaning":"Extracts the strict order relation.","effect_on_target":"Expresses positive dimension and strictly increasing spatial and temporal endpoints.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace","meaning":"Extracts a measure space's measurable-space structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the measurable sets on the real integration domain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume","meaning":"Extracts a measure space's distinguished measure.","effect_on_target":"Every integral and region average uses the same distinguished real volume measure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"Nat","meaning":"The natural numbers, including zero.","effect_on_target":"The vector dimension m is a natural number, subsequently required to be positive.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative monoid structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real additive structure to the pointwise module construction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity while retaining seminormed ring operations.","effect_on_target":"Part of obtaining the real seminormed additive structure, with no additional assumption.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains a ring's norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real coordinate seminormed additive structure for scalar actions and integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative associativity as a required property of the retained structure.","effect_on_target":"Part of extracting the real additive monoid; operations remain unchanged.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"Norm.norm","meaning":"Extracts the real-valued norm function.","effect_on_target":"Measures the old, left-flux, right-flux, and updated errors using the selected finite-product norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup","meaning":"Retains the norm, additive group, and metric while forgetting commutativity as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"Provides coordinate structures used to build the integrability norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Constructs an extended-nonnegative-valued normed additive monoid from a normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the extended norm used by interval integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"NormedCommRing.toNormedRing","meaning":"Extracts the underlying normed ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real coordinate normed rings for the product norm in the bound.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains the ring, norm, and pseudometric while dropping norm separation as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"Preserves real operations and norm in the normed-space instance chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"NormedRing.toNorm","meaning":"Extracts a normed ring's norm.","effect_on_target":"Selects the norm from the finite-product normed ring for each error inequality.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","meaning":"Extracts the underlying module structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real scalar multiplication to the algebraic update definition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"OfNat.ofNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural numeral in its selected type.","effect_on_target":"Interprets zero as the natural number zero in 0<m.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"Pi.Function.module","meaning":"Functions into a module form a module with pointwise operations.","effect_on_target":"The update acts on real coordinate vectors as a real module.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"Pi.addCommGroup","meaning":"Functions into additive commutative groups form a pointwise additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies vector subtraction and addition to the update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"Pi.instAdd","meaning":"Defines (f+g)(i)=f(i)+g(i).","effect_on_target":"Every vector sum is coordinatewise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"Pi.instSub","meaning":"Defines (f-g)(i)=f(i)-g(i).","effect_on_target":"Every vector error and flux difference is coordinatewise and preserves the displayed operand order.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"Pi.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Builds the finite-product normed additive commutative group, inheriting its norm and pseudometric from Pi.seminormedAddGroup.","effect_on_target":"Provides the vector structure for all integrals and averages; the inherited norm formula is not expanded in the packet.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"Pi.normedAddGroup","meaning":"Builds the finite-product normed additive group from Pi.seminormedAddGroup.","effect_on_target":"Provides the vector norm structure for integrability; the underlying norm formula is not displayed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"Pi.normedRing","meaning":"Builds a finite-product normed ring, taking its norm from Pi.seminormedRing.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the exact norm used in the error estimate; the packet does not expand that norm into a coordinate formula.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"Pi.normedSpace","meaning":"Builds a normed space of finite coordinate families using the pointwise module action.","effect_on_target":"Supports vector-valued integration and real scaling of the averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"Pi.topologicalSpace","meaning":"The product topology, constructed from the coordinate evaluation maps.","effect_on_target":"Integrability uses the product of the real coordinate topologies.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","meaning":"Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.","effect_on_target":"Carries the real absolute-difference metric into the topology used for integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal","meaning":"Constructs the real inner-product-space structure of an RCLike field, with its underlying normed-algebra scalar action.","effect_on_target":"At Real, provides the real coordinate space over itself; no vector inner product appears in the proposition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"Real","meaning":"The real number type.","effect_on_target":"Coordinates, space and time variables, scalar factors, and error bounds are real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"Real.instAdd","meaning":"The real addition operation.","effect_on_target":"Adds coordinates and combines the real bounds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","meaning":"The additive commutative group structure on the real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Supplies coordinate addition, zero, negation, and subtraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"Real.instCommSemiring","meaning":"The commutative semiring structure on the real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Supports the identity real algebra and its scalar action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"Real.instDivInvMonoid","meaning":"Real multiplication and inversion with division defined as multiplication by inverse.","effect_on_target":"Interprets (t-s)/(b-a); the denominator is positive by hypothesis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"Real.instLE","meaning":"The real non-strict order.","effect_on_target":"Compares norms with real bounds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"Real.instLT","meaning":"The real strict order.","effect_on_target":"Requires a<b and s<t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"Real.instMul","meaning":"The real multiplication operation.","effect_on_target":"Multiplies the time-to-length ratio by the sum of flux bounds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Real.instPreorder","meaning":"The preorder structure underlying real order.","effect_on_target":"Defines the half-open regions using real endpoint comparisons.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"Real.instRCLike","meaning":"The real numbers as an RCLike field, with identity real part, zero imaginary part, and the real normed algebra over itself.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the coordinate real normed-space construction, without introducing complex coordinates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"Real.instRing","meaning":"The ring structure on the real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the additive and multiplicative operations needed for vector modules.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"Real.instSub","meaning":"Real subtraction a-b is a plus the negative of b.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the signs of interval lengths, flux differences, and coordinate errors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"Real.measureSpace","meaning":"The selected measure-space instance on Real; its displayed body is inferInstance.","effect_on_target":"Determines the integration measure and region masses. Its construction and normalization are not exposed by this body.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"The real additive group equipped with Real.norm and Real.metricSpace.","effect_on_target":"Provides coordinate norm and metric structures for the vector integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"Real.normedCommRing","meaning":"Combines the real normed additive group with the real commutative ring, retaining their operations and norm.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real coordinate normed-ring structure in the error norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"Real.normedField","meaning":"The real field equipped with its real norm and metric, including totalized inversion with inverse zero equal to zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the scalar normed field for all normed spaces and normalized integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"The real pseudometric d(x,y)=|x-y|.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the usual real topology used in the vector product topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"Real.semiring","meaning":"The real semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides the scalar semiring for the pointwise module.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"Ring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the semiring structure of a ring.","effect_on_target":"Retains real addition and multiplication for module construction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains the norm, additive group, multiplication, and pseudometric while dropping the multiplicative-unit requirement.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real seminormed structure used by the coordinate normed space.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring","meaning":"Extracts a semiring structure without requiring a multiplicative unit.","effect_on_target":"Part of obtaining the real additive monoid without changing operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"Set.Ioc","meaning":"The set of x satisfying a<x and x≤b.","effect_on_target":"The averaging regions are precisely (a,b] and (s,t], and interval integrals use corresponding oriented regions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","meaning":"Extracts the topology of a uniform space.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real coordinate topology used in integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"instHAdd","meaning":"Uses ordinary addition as same-type heterogeneous addition.","effect_on_target":"The displayed additions are the selected real or pointwise additions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"instHDiv","meaning":"Uses ordinary division as same-type heterogeneous division.","effect_on_target":"The displayed ratio uses real division.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"instHMul","meaning":"Uses ordinary multiplication as same-type heterogeneous multiplication.","effect_on_target":"The final scalar bound uses real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"instHSMul","meaning":"Uses a scalar action as heterogeneous scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"The displayed vector scalings use the selected real module action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"instHSub","meaning":"Uses ordinary subtraction as same-type heterogeneous subtraction.","effect_on_target":"The displayed differences use real or coordinatewise subtraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"instLTNat","meaning":"Natural-number strict order.","effect_on_target":"The hypothesis and first conclusion require m>0.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"instOfNatNat","meaning":"Interprets each natural numeral as itself.","effect_on_target":"The dimension condition compares m with natural zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"intervalIntegral","meaning":"The integral restricted to (a,b] minus the integral restricted to (b,a].","effect_on_target":"Fixes orientation and signs in the balance assumption and normalized averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"AddCommGroup","meaning":"An additive group whose addition is commutative.","effect_on_target":"The generic update uses this structure; the target supplies it pointwise on real vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Retains commutative addition and zero from an additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies additive structure for scalar module operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddGroup","meaning":"Extracts the additive group structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies subtraction-related structure inside the update definition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid","meaning":"Retains addition, zero, negation, and subtraction from an additive group.","effect_on_target":"Makes the update's vector subtraction available.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass","meaning":"Retains addition and its zero identity.","effect_on_target":"Supplies zero structure needed by scalar-action projections.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"AddZero.toZero","meaning":"Extracts the zero element.","effect_on_target":"Provides the vector zero underlying scalar action and integration structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"AddZeroClass.toAddZero","meaning":"Retains addition and zero.","effect_on_target":"Part of the zero-instance chain; adds no hypothesis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"DFunLike.coe","meaning":"Coerces a function-like object to its underlying function.","effect_on_target":"Allows evaluating a measure on a region for normalization.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul","meaning":"Retains a scalar action distributing over addition and preserving zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the scalar action used by the update and averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass","meaning":"Retains a scalar action that preserves zero.","effect_on_target":"Part of extracting the module's scalar multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"ENNReal","meaning":"Nonnegative real numbers with an additional top element representing infinity.","effect_on_target":"Region measures have this extended nonnegative codomain before conversion to Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"ENNReal.toReal","meaning":"Converts through ENNReal.toNNReal and then NNReal.toReal.","effect_on_target":"Produces the real normalization denominator in region averages; behavior at infinity is not expanded in the packet.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D092","name":"ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Retains an extended seminormed commutative additive monoid while dropping separation as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"Supplies inherited structures inside the integrability and average predicates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D093","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts commutative addition and zero from an extended seminormed additive structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides additive structure without imposing further conditions on the fields.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D094","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the extended seminormed additive monoid structure.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the extended norm used by integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D095","name":"ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition and zero in inherited integration-related structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D096","name":"Inv.inv","meaning":"Extracts the selected inversion operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms reciprocals of interval lengths and converted region measures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D097","name":"MeasurableSpace","meaning":"A measurable-space structure specifying a sigma-algebra of sets.","effect_on_target":"The generic region-average definition needs such a structure; the target uses the one on Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D098","name":"MeasureTheory.Measure","meaning":"A measure on a measurable space with extended nonnegative values.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the measure parameter to integrals and region averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D099","name":"MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike","meaning":"Evaluates a measure on sets through its underlying outer measure.","effect_on_target":"The region-average denominator uses the actual measure of the half-open region.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D100","name":"MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict","meaning":"Applies the measure restriction operator associated with the specified set.","effect_on_target":"Restricts integration to the half-open spatial or temporal regions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D101","name":"MeasureTheory.integral","meaning":"The vector-valued integral operation, whose displayed body is an opaque wrapped projection.","effect_on_target":"All reference averages and the balance assumption depend on this operation; the packet does not expose its analytic construction or exceptional-case behavior.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D102","name":"Module","meaning":"An additive commutative monoid with a semiring scalar action satisfying the module laws.","effect_on_target":"The update is defined in a real module, instantiated by coordinate vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D103","name":"Module.toDistribMulAction","meaning":"Extracts the module's multiplicative scalar action distributing over addition.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the scalar action used in the generic update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D104","name":"NormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"An additive commutative group with a separating norm and compatible metric.","effect_on_target":"Provides the generic vector structure required by the integral and average definitions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D105","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Constructs the corresponding extended-normed additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Makes integrability available inside the average predicate using the inherited norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D106","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the seminormed structure required by generic normed spaces.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D107","name":"NormedSpace","meaning":"A module over a normed field whose scalar action satisfies the norm compatibility bound.","effect_on_target":"Supports real scalar multiplication and vector-valued integration in the average definitions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D108","name":"Real.instInv","meaning":"The selected real inverse operation.","effect_on_target":"Normalizes by reciprocal lengths and region measures; positive lengths exclude zero-length division.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D109","name":"Real.instMonoid","meaning":"The real multiplicative monoid structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies multiplication and one to real division and scalar actions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D110","name":"SMulZeroClass.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts scalar multiplication from a zero-preserving scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the actual action in the module-based update definition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D111","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Extracts the pseudometric associated with the seminormed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Provides the topology-related structure used by integrability in the average predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D112","name":"Set","meaning":"A set of elements of a type is a predicate on that type.","effect_on_target":"Regions such as (a,b] are subsets described by membership propositions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D113","name":"SubNegMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts addition and zero from a subtraction-and-negation monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies additive structure for the update's module action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D114","name":"SubNegMonoid.toSub","meaning":"Extracts subtraction from a subtraction-and-negation monoid.","effect_on_target":"The update subtracts the scaled outward flux from the old vector.","status":"understood"}
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every natural number m satisfying 0<m, let V be the real coordinate space Fin m → Real, with coordinates indexed by integers i satisfying 0≤i<m and with the product structures specified in the dossier.",
      "For arbitrary types Cell and Face, quantify universally over q: Real → Real → V, flux: V → V, numericalOld: Cell → V, and rule: (Cell → V) → Face → V.",
      "Quantify universally over cell∈Cell, leftFace∈Face, rightFace∈Face, and real numbers a,b,s,t.",
      "In the last conjunct, quantify universally over real numbers oldBound, leftBound, and rightBound. Their three norm inequalities are premises of that conjunct, not premises required for the preceding conclusions.",
      "There are no existentially quantified witnesses. All averages and the updated vector are fixed expressions depending on the universally supplied data."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "The dimension satisfies 0<m.",
      "The spatial endpoints satisfy a<b and the temporal endpoints satisfy s<t.",
      "The field x↦q(x,s) is interval integrable from a to b with respect to μ, where μ is the volume measure selected by Real.measureSpace.",
      "The field x↦q(x,t) is interval integrable from a to b with respect to μ.",
      "The field τ↦flux(q(a,τ)) is interval integrable from s to t with respect to μ.",
      "The field τ↦flux(q(b,τ)) is interval integrable from s to t with respect to μ.",
      "The exact vector balance holds: ∫_a^b q(x,t) dμ(x) − ∫_a^b q(x,s) dμ(x) = ∫_s^t [flux(q(a,τ)) − flux(q(b,τ))] dμ(τ)."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "All the following clauses hold simultaneously, beginning with the repeated assertion 0<m.",
      "For Q_s=A(x↦q(x,s);a,b): a<b, the spatial field at s is interval integrable, and Q_s=A(x↦q(x,s);a,b).",
      "For Q_t=A(x↦q(x,t);a,b): a<b, the spatial field at t is interval integrable, and Q_t=A(x↦q(x,t);a,b).",
      "For F_L=A(τ↦flux(q(a,τ));s,t): s<t, the left flux field is interval integrable, and F_L=A(τ↦flux(q(a,τ));s,t).",
      "For F_R=A(τ↦flux(q(b,τ));s,t): s<t, the right flux field is interval integrable, and F_R=A(τ↦flux(q(b,τ));s,t).",
      "Q_s = ((μ((a,b])).toReal) inverse) · ∫_(a,b] q(x,s) dμ(x).",
      "F_L = ((μ((s,t])).toReal) inverse) · ∫_(s,t] flux(q(a,τ)) dμ(τ).",
      "Writing h=b-a, k=t-s, U=numericalOld(cell), N_L=rule(numericalOld)(leftFace), N_R=rule(numericalOld)(rightFace), and U_new=LocalDef003(k,h,U,N_R−N_L), the update expansion is U_new=U−(k/h)·(N_R−N_L).",
      "The exact vector error identity is h·(U_new−Q_t)=h·(U−Q_s)+k·[(N_L−F_L)−(N_R−F_R)].",
      "For every oldBound,leftBound,rightBound∈Real, if ||U−Q_s||_P≤oldBound, ||N_L−F_L||_P≤leftBound, and ||N_R−F_R||_P≤rightBound, then ||U_new−Q_t||_P≤oldBound+(k/h)(leftBound+rightBound)."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "All vector additions, subtractions, and real scalar actions are coordinatewise; vector equality means equality at every i∈Fin m.",
      "μ denotes the distinguished measure Real.measureSpace.volume. Retaining this designation avoids assuming an unexpanded normalization of that instance.",
      "For real l,r, (l,r] denotes {x∈Real : l<x and x≤r}.",
      "The oriented integral ∫_l^r f dμ is defined as the integral with respect to μ restricted to (l,r], minus the integral with respect to μ restricted to (r,l].",
      "Interval integrability of f from l to r means integrability on both (l,r] and (r,l].",
      "A(f;l,r)=(r−l) inverse · ∫_l^r f dμ.",
      "The region-average operation for a measure ν and region S is ((ν(S)).toReal) inverse · ∫ f d(ν restricted to S).",
      "Q_s and Q_t are the two spatial averages of q over the same endpoints a,b; F_L and F_R are temporal averages of flux composed with the two boundary fields at spatial locations a and b.",
      "The notation ||v||_P denotes exactly the norm extracted from the displayed Pi.normedRing instance on Fin m → Real. Its coordinate formula is not expanded in the supplied dependency bodies.",
